title: Project Manager
description:
PROJECT MANAGER – EXPERIENTIAL DESIGN & PROJECTS

Company: Swaparichay Studios  
Location: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
Employment Type: Full-Time  
Experience Required: 5–8 Years

ABOUT THE ROLE

Swaparichay Studios is looking for an experienced and proactive Project Manager to lead and execute museum, exhibition, event, experience centre, retail, and spatial design projects from concept development through execution and final installation.

The ideal candidate should have strong project management, client coordination, vendor management, team leadership, planning, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage projects from initial planning through execution and final handover.
* Handle coordination with clients, vendors, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
* Coordinate with design, production, fabrication, and site execution teams.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, procurement, and logistics.
* Conduct client meetings, site visits, project reviews, and coordination meetings.
* Monitor project progress, quality, risks, and deliverables.
* Track project schedules and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Identify project-related challenges and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Manage vendor and contractor follow-ups to ensure timely execution.
* Coordinate material procurement, fabrication, transportation, installation, and site activities.
* Maintain project documentation, reports, trackers, drawings, quotations, approvals, and other relevant records.
* Provide regular project updates to management and clients.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and client requirements.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining proper coordination and documentation.

KEY SKILLS

* Project Management
* Client Management
* Vendor Coordination
* Budget and Cost Control
* Team Leadership
* Site Execution
* Procurement and Logistics
* Risk Management
* Project Planning and Scheduling
* Problem-Solving
* Communication and Coordination

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Knowledge or experience with the following tools will be preferred:

* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* MS Office
* MS Project
* Primavera
* Trello
* Asana
* Monday.com

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:

* Museum Projects
* Exhibition Projects
* Events and Brand Activations
* Experience Centres
* Retail and Corporate Spaces
* Experiential Design
* Spatial Design
* Interior and Built Environment Projects

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* 5–8 years of relevant project management experience.
* Strong experience in handling projects from planning through execution and handover.
* Excellent client, vendor, consultant, and team coordination skills.
* Strong understanding of project timelines, budgets, procurement, and execution.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proactive, organized, and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel for site visits and project requirements when required.

WHY JOIN US?

Join Swaparichay Studios and work on creative, large-scale experiential projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary design, creative, production, and execution teams.

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV and portfolio/project profile.

Only candidates whose skills and experience closely match the requirements of the position will be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
